cards.title: Vancouver heritage character review response due Wednesday
cards.body: Commercial Drive Fourplex submitted to City of Vancouver heritage 22 days ago. Response window opens this Wednesday. Framing crew is on standby; further delay pushes critical path into the rainy season.

cards.title: New Toolbox lead — Sarah Chen, fourplex on East Pender
cards.body: SHBC Toolbox visitor picked BC Standardized #BCS-FX-04 for lot 2231 East Pender (Vancouver R1-1). Estimated budget $1.65M CAD. Matched to East Van Density Studio on typology + municipality.

cards.title: Buchanan Sixplex (Aldergrove): Hydro underground service slipping — MEP sync requested
cards.body: Aldergrove Build Co. flagged a 3-week slip on the Buchanan Sixplex hydro trench. They use Houle Electric — same crew that's slated for the Mount Pleasant Fourplex MEP rough-in in 6 weeks. Cohort sync requested.

cards.title: Framing lumber for Commercial Drive Fourplex flipped to CRITICAL overnight
cards.body: ProcurementCheckWorker flipped the lumber package from WARNING to CRITICAL — must-order date passed yesterday. Doman quote $84,000 CAD, 18-day lead + 7-day weather buffer.

cards.title: Mount Pleasant Fourplex schedule recovered 4 days from weather buffer
cards.body: SWIM model reabsorbed 4 days of weather buffer after a clear forecast for May 1–14. Critical path now 4 days ahead of baseline.

cards.title: Maria Hernandez — BC Housing Licensed Builder expires in 47 days
cards.body: CertificationAlertsWorker flagged this in the nightly sweep. Renewal lead time is typically 30 days; book the application now to avoid project blocks.

cards.title: BC Hydro underground trench in queue for 47 days — schedule slip risk
cards.body: BC Hydro West queue at 11 weeks; project critical path was costed at 8 weeks. Currently 6 weeks behind on framing → MEP transition.

cards.title: Brackendale Laneway Class A roofing — must order in 8 days
cards.body: Convoy Supply quote on standing-seam Class A roof. WUI compliance required (Squamish bylaw). 28-day lead + 14-day weather buffer factored in.

cards.title: Nelson HCA design review — revised drawings due in 12 days
cards.body: Heritage Conservation Area session 2026-04-22 produced 3 design notes (eave detail, porch column proportion, window mullion spacing). Drawings due 2026-05-12.

cards.title: New Toolbox lead — Avery Olsen, triplex in Maple Ridge
cards.body: Avery picked BC Standardized #BCS-TX-01 for 835 Yates St (Maple Ridge RS-1). Pre-design review booked for next week.
